title: Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines help uplift local communities during Week of CARE
summary: During this year’s Week of CARE event, employees participated in 26 projects across 9 different states.

**About Alaska, Hawaiian and Horizon**


Alaska Airlines, Hawaiian Airlines and Horizon Air are subsidiaries of Alaska Air Group, and McGee Air Services is a subsidiary of Alaska Airlines. We are a global airline with hubs in Seattle, Honolulu, Portland, Anchorage, Los Angeles, San


Diego


and San Francisco. We deliver remarkable care as we fly our guests to more than 140 destinations throughout North America, Latin America, Asia, the
